unsearched_scope_and_limitations: This is not a whole-package content search. Python files outside the listed prefixes and path-substring candidates are not read, except five explicit required sources.

A caller in an unrelated filename/directory, or a dynamically assembled import that lacks the literal tokens, can be missed. Native-side imports and symbol loading cannot be established by this Python scan.
AST import statements may be inside functions, branches, exception handlers or TYPE_CHECKING. The report records source syntax and lines, not observed execution or unconditional reachability.
No matches means not located within this finite collection. It never means fs_io_C/spinloop is globally unused or cannot be imported.
If a size/count/findings cap is exceeded, fail before further reading or a success result. Do not silently truncate source selection or expand the search automatically.
Original event-stream completion and SHA256 must be verified through EOF before installed source reads. Every selected file must retain its original wheel-member digest and saved file identity.

fresh_process_requirements_source.excerpt:
def _check_process(context):
    require(sys.executable==str(ENV/'bin/python') and sys.prefix==str(ENV)
            and sys.flags.optimize==0 and sys.dont_write_bytecode and sys.flags.no_user_site,
            'Fresh original CPU interpreter with assertions/no bytecode/no user site')
    require(all(os.environ.get(k)==v for k,v in context['environment'].items())
            and not os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH') and not os.environ.get('PYTHONHOME'),
            'Exact original CPU/offline/thread/preload environment without path overrides')
    require(not any(name.split('.')[0] in ('torch','numpy','vllm','transformers','tokenizers','pytest','_pytest')
                    for name in sys.modules), 'Authenticate before any native/test package import')
    require(UPSTREAM_NAME not in sys.modules,'No prior upstream module in this fresh worker')
